title: Lobster Eclipse Ritual
description: A large orange lobster floats centrally above a circular reflecting pool, surrounded by transparent bubbles each containing miniature landscapes with a sun or moon. Below, a group of robed figures stands around the pool with arms raised in ritualistic poses. The scene is framed by flowering vines and set against a twilight sky featuring a prominent eclipsed sun with radiating light.
prompt: A surreal stained glass style illustration featuring a giant vibrant orange lobster floating above a circular reflecting pool. The lobster is surrounded by transparent bubbles containing miniature scenes of landscapes with suns and moons. At the bottom, a group of robed figures with raised arms performs a ritual around the pool. Flowering vines frame the sides, with a large eclipsed sun radiating light in a twilight sky. Intricate black leading lines, vibrant colors, detailed and symbolic.
